nodes.name: On Workflow Failure
nodes.notes: Fires when a workflow that names this one as its error workflow fails. Before this existed a failed run left no row anywhere: successful executions are not stored by n8n here, and the run summary is written by the last node, which a failed run never reaches. NOTE: n8n refuses to run an error workflow that is not published — it logs 'is not active and cannot be executed' and the failure goes unrecorded.

nodes.name: Build Failure Summary
nodes.notes: Turns n8n's error payload into one INSERT with the failing node named. Escapes quotes by hand because the Postgres node splits query parameters on commas.

nodes.name: Record Failure
nodes.notes: Writes the failure row straight into mnemora_runs with the same credential the persist workflow uses. Deliberately not through the write pipe: the pipe is the component most likely to be the thing that failed, and a failure logger that depends on it records nothing when it matters.

nodes.name: Release Lease
nodes.notes: Deletes the failed run's own lease, so one transient error does not block every later tick until the TTL expires. Scoped to run_id: if another run holds the lease it is left alone, because that run may still be alive.
